snippet.title: Metroidvania Maker - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Metroidvania Maker lets you build, play and share custom Metroidvania worlds.

Explore a handcrafted campaign filled with hidden paths, abilities, platforming challenges, and boss fights, or use the built-in editor to create entirely new adventures of your own.

Build interconnected worlds room-by-room, place enemies and gameplay objects, create puzzles and logic systems, and instantly playtest your creations directly inside the game.

#MetroidvaniaMaker #metroidvania #indiegame
